name: The Pit
about_text: The Pit is a contemporary art gallery in Los Angeles founded in 2014 by artists Adam D. Miller and Devon Oder. It began as an artist-run, artist-curated project space in a former mechanics garage in Glendale before relocating, after a decade, to a larger complex in Atwater Village designed by JK & Co. The gallery represents and exhibits emerging, mid-career and established artists across generations, with a program grounded in dialogue with historical California art traditions, emphasizing material exploration, design, and counterculture influences. The Pit participates in major national and international art fairs and is a member of several art-dealer associations.
